bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
n=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$n")" = true || exit 21
test "$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ec 'createvdobot|create-videobot|videobot-poll' || true)" -eq 1 || exit 22
docker exec "$n" grep -q 'plain /start belongs to the common home menu' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/stickerWizard.mjs || exit 23
docker exec "$n" grep -q 'ステッカー・絵文字' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/menuPanel.mjs || exit 24
docker logs --tail 1000 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' || exit 25
docker logs --tail 1000 "$n" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_GATE_PUBLIC_RELEASE=CONNECTED$' || exit 26
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
name='gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1'
raw=subprocess.check_output(['docker','inspect',name],text=True)
obj=json.loads(raw)[0]
tokenfile=next(m['Source'] for m in obj['Mounts'] if m['Destination']=='/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token')
from urllib.request import urlopen
token=Path(tokenfile).read_text().strip()
def api(method):
 with urlopen('https://api.telegram.org/bot'+token+'/'+method,timeout=14) as r: return json.load(r)
me=api('getMe')
assert me.get('ok') and me['result'].get('is_bot'), 'BOT_API_IDENTITY_FAIL'
assert 'creat' in me['result']['username'].lower() or 'vdo' in me['result']['username'].lower(), 'BOT_USERNAME_UNEXPECTED'
info=api('getWebhookInfo')
assert info.get('ok') and not info['result'].get('url'), 'BOT_WEBHOOK_CONFLICT'
commands=api('getMyCommands')
assert commands.get('ok'), 'BOT_COMMAND_READBACK_FAIL'
print('BOT_API_GETME=PASS')
print('BOT_API_POLL_MODE=PASS')
print('BOT_CONFIGURED_COMMAND_COUNT='+str(len(commands['result'])))
PY
echo CREATEVDOBOT_RUNTIME_HEALTH_AND_PATCH=PASS
